verdict.rationale: Docs say agents can be built with "no code required": you add connectors, triggers, and skills, and the agent itself decides which tools to call and in what order. That gives no-code multi-step automation, but through goal-driven agents rather than workflows an ops user lays out explicitly, and nothing in the pack describes a visual canvas or drag-and-drop flow editor. The 'nodes' URL path and SDK references to 'automations' only hint at such a builder. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of a visual workflow editor or canvas, user-defined step-by-step flow construction (branching, sequencing), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the no-code building experience.
